integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic sports footage, a low static-ish angle near lane level frames several university sprinters crouched in their starting blocks on the straightaway of a bright indoor track and field arena, fingers on the polished surface, bodies coiled and muscles taut. Overhead arena lights glint off the track as the athletes hold still in total focus. A starting signal fires, and the sprinters explode out of the blocks in unison, driving low with powerful strides and pumping arms while spikes bite into the track. [Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a smooth lateral tracking shot gliding alongside the lane at slow, restrained speed as the athletes rise into full upright sprinting form, accelerating at maximum effort down the straightaway. Lane lines blur beneath them, their faces show intense determination, and the rhythm of footfalls quickens as they drive toward the finish zone at top speed.

overall_soundscape: A sharp starting signal cracks through the hush of the arena, followed by an explosive burst of spikes striking the track, heavy synchronized breathing, and the whoosh of bodies slicing through the air, with a faint arena reverb underneath.

non_diegetic_music: Driving percussive pulse with low strings at a moderate-to-fast tempo, building steadily in intensity and volume as the sprint accelerates, sustaining through the final push.
